ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips; estimated ratio of 70:30 black-to-white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-contrast white regions located at the far left and right distal tips. The left tip contains a large contiguous white blob extending from the tip towards the center, interspersed with black mottling. The right tip shows a similar but smaller white area. The central and lower regions are primarily low-intensity black with sparse high-intensity speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle estimated at approximately 45 degrees, partially occluded by water turbulence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along both lobes. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits a sequence of small-amplitude, high-frequency peaks. Right lobe trailing edge shows larger, more rounded peaks towards the tip and smaller irregular variations towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep of the outer lobe edges, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-contrast white clusters detected primarily within the dark central regions and at the margins of the white distal patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear white streaks detected. Notable diagonal rake marks on the inner left lobe and several shorter, crisscrossing linear disruptions on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of parallel linear rake marks across the fluke surface; irregular notches on the trailing edge suggesting past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical distribution of white pigmentation on the distal tips, with the left tip showing a more extensive white field than the right.
